bots.name: Goblin Storm
bots.status: shipped (v4, with answer rules); among bots +13.5 points on its stock pilot, confirmed, and +4.0 on version 3
bots.summary: Aims its single-target spells at Zada and keeps her back until she can be aimed at, runs Krenko, keeps rituals and Empty the Warrens for the turn they pay, attacks the highest life; version 4 also casts Blasphemous Act when it faces lethal against a wider board and finishes with Grapeshot and Goblin Bombardment.

tables.run: ab-run #21 joined with #20: 200 tables whose three opponents are the other three bots under their playbooks (version 3 of this deck won 30 of the same tables)

bots.name: Hail, Caesar
bots.status: shipped (v4, with answer rules); among bots +15.0 points on its stock pilot and +9.5 on version 3, confirmed
bots.summary: Cast rules plus one trigger rule: Caesar's attack trigger is taken whenever there is a token to give up (Forge's AI declines it four times in five); version 4 also casts its board wipes (Ruinous Ultimatum, Martial Coup, Vault 75, Hour of Reckoning, The Nipton Lottery) when the table calls for them.
